name: rosetta-last-friday-of-each-month
code:
use default
use System

last_friday(year: int, month: int) -> DateTime is
    let candidate mut = DateTime(year, month,
        DateTime.days_in_month(year, month))

    while candidate.day_of_week !~ DayOfWeek.FRIDAY do
        candidate = candidate.add_days(-1.0D)
    od

    candidate
si

last_fridays(year: int) -> Pipe[DateTime] is
    for month in 1::12 do
        yield last_friday(year, month)
    od
si

let year = 2012

last_fridays(year)
    |> each(friday => write_line("{friday:yyyy-MM-dd}"))
